title: XAUUSD: long Tokyo cash open → London cash open (bid/ask session drift)
power_gate_note: Power Gate V1.4 cannot certify POWER_READY without a preregistered level calibration (NEXUS_POWER_GATE_V1). Until then every run of this hypothesis is EXPLORATORY_ONLY. Never promote to VALIDATED from this experiment alone.
data_access_statement: Written in a cloud container that has no copy of the Phase 7 tick files and cannot reach Dukascopy. No outcome, event count or price of this family has been computed on any period before this file was committed.
question: Is the mean net long return of XAUUSD from Tokyo cash open to London cash open (entry on ask, exit on bid) strictly positive after costs, greater than a duration-scaled generic gold rise over the same days, stable across calendar years, and same-signed on two preregistered discovery windows?
primary_outcome: mean_net_return_usd: arithmetic mean of (exit_bid - entry_ask - commission) over closed weekday sessions

comparator.definition: For the same Tokyo-open calendar day, net return from Tokyo open ask to next Tokyo open bid (full Tokyo→Tokyo). Scale by duration_tokyo_london / duration_tokyo_tokyo. Delta = session_net - scaled_day_net. Falsify if mean delta ≤ 0 (session does not beat proportional generic rise).

param_provenance.tokyo_open_local: Asia/Tokyo cash open 09:00 local (DST-aware via zoneinfo); aligns with behavior_lab_v1/sessions.py TOKYO window start
param_provenance.london_open_local: Europe/London cash open 08:00 local (DST-aware); aligns with behavior_lab_v1/sessions.py LONDON window start
param_provenance.bid_ask: Long entry on ask_open of the matched M15 bar; exit on bid_open of the London-open bar — same fill-side convention as behavior_lab_v1
param_provenance.commission_usd_per_oz: 0: Dukascopy spread only. Broker commission not modelled; results are an upper bound for a commission account
param_provenance.year_concentration_max_share: 0.5 chosen a priori: if one calendar year accounts for more than half of the sum of positive yearly means, treat as concentration falsifier

timezone_policy.session_clocks: local IANA zones Asia/Tokyo and Europe/London — never fixed UTC hours
timezone_policy.bar_grid: UTC-aligned M15 as in behavior_lab_v1/bars.py / phase7_1
timezone_policy.rationale: London and US DST move the UTC clock of cash opens; fixed-GMT windows would mix regimes

discovery_b.access: ITERABLE for this hypothesis only; used for sign-stability falsifier vs discovery_a

internal_validation.access: ONE_SHOT after both discoveries pass decision rules with frozen params; max decision PRE_REGISTERED_CANDIDATE / EXPLORATORY_ONLY

excluded_phase7_sealed_holdout.access: PHYSICALLY_EXCLUDED — Phase 7 sealed holdout; runner refuses

forward_after_seal.access: NOT in V1 runner; future independence window after seal

falsification.F1_ci_includes_zero: On combined discovery_a∪discovery_b, month-block bootstrap 95% CI for mean_net_return_usd includes ≤ 0 → FAIL
falsification.F2_does_not_beat_generic_gold: Mean delta_vs_generic_gold_scaled ≤ 0 on combined discoveries → FAIL
falsification.F3_year_concentration: Among years with n≥20 in combined discoveries, one year share of sum(max(yearly_mean,0)) > year_concentration_max_share → FAIL
falsification.F4_sign_flip_across_discoveries: sign(mean_net discovery_a) != sign(mean_net discovery_b) when both n≥min_n_per_discovery → FAIL
falsification.insufficient_n: Any discovery with n_closed < min_n_per_discovery → INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (distinct from FAIL)

decision_vocabulary.FAIL: At least one falsifier F1–F4 fires with adequate n
decision_vocabulary.EXPLORATORY_PROMISING: No falsifier fires; still EXPLORATORY_ONLY / not POWER_READY / not VALIDATED
decision_vocabulary.VALIDATED: FORBIDDEN for this hypothesis_id — requires separate promotion gate with power + true holdout + parity

exposure_statement.this_hypothesis: No period has been read for this hypothesis.
exposure_statement.neighbouring_studies: Phase 7 / MT5 studies traversed 2023–2026 for breakout/OB/sweep families. Session-drift is a different estimand (1 obs/day, fixed clock), but calendar overlap means internal_validation is not a virgin TRUE_HOLDOUT.
exposure_statement.consequence: Maximum after internal_validation: EXPLORATORY_PROMISING under evidence_ceiling EXPLORATORY_ONLY. Independence for any stronger claim needs data after 2026-09-17 or an unused public history window under a new hypothesis_id.
exposure_statement.rule: Parameters may change only under a new hypothesis_id. Runner refuses a run whose params hash differs from an earlier run of the same hypothesis_id.
